—My foot feels like lead. —There a cramp in my arm. —That’s gout. —My big toe tickles. —My whole back aches. —This must be the biggest treasure trove ever.

@@U02294@@
Then hurry! You wont slip away this time! Prove your blathering lies are true! Show us these noble chambers, now! [ll lay down my sword and scepter and dig with my own imperial hands and finish the job. And if it’s a lie, I'll send you to Hell.

@@U02296@@
(Aside.)

@@U02297@@
I dare say I could find my way there, all right.

@@U02298@@
(Aloud.)

@@U02299@@
But I can’t stress enough the unclaimed wealth waiting to be discovered everywhere. The farmer plowing his field turns up a pot of gold; scraping saltpeter from its clay sides, trembling with joy, he finds in his destitute hand a roll of the purest gold. As for that man with a nose for treasure, what vaults there are to be blown open, what clefts and passages must be passed through to arrive at the region bordering the underworld! There in spacious cellars long sealed off, he will see row upon ordered row of tankards of gold, bowls, plates, goblets in abundance made of rubies,

——我的脚感觉像灌了铅。 ——我的手臂抽筋了。 ——那是痛风。 ——我的大脚趾发痒。 ——我整个背都酸痛。 ——这一定是有史以来最大的宝库了。

@@U02294@@
那就快点吧！这次你不会再溜了！证明你的谎言是真的！现在就向我们展示这些高贵的房间！ [我将放下我的剑和权杖，用我自己的帝国之手挖掘并完成工作。如果这是谎言，我会把你送进地狱。

@@U02296@@
（旁边。）

@@U02297@@
我敢说我能找到路，好吧。

@@U02298@@
（大声）

@@U02299@@
但我无法充分强调到处都有无人认领的财富等待被发现。农夫耕田，收获一桶金；他高兴得浑身发抖，把粘土上的硝石刮下来，在他那贫乏的手里发现了一卷最纯的金子。对于那个有着宝藏嗅觉的人来说，要炸开什么样的金库，要穿过什么样的裂缝和通道，才能到达与冥界接壤的地方！在长期封闭的宽敞地窖里，他会看到一排排排列整齐的金酒杯、碗、盘子、高脚杯，大量由红宝石制成，
